titles.title: New Girl
titles.description: After a bad break-up, Jess, an offbeat young woman, moves into an apartment loft with three single men. Although they find her behavior very unusual, the men support her - most of the time.

titles.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
titles.description: The missions of the Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division.

titles.title: You
titles.description: A charming and intense young man inserts himself into the lives of women who fascinate him.

titles.title: Dexter
titles.description: He's smart. He's lovable. He's Dexter Morgan, America's favorite serial killer, who spends his days solving crimes and his nights committing them.

titles.title: Fear the Walking Dead
titles.description: A Walking Dead spinoff set in Los Angeles, California. Follows two families who must band together to survive the undead apocalypse.

titles.description: In a wacky Rhode Island town, a dysfunctional family strives to cope with everyday life as they are thrown from one crazy scenario to another.

titles.title: Lost
titles.description: The survivors of a plane crash are forced to work together in order to survive on a seemingly deserted tropical island.

titles.title: Peaky Blinders
titles.description: A gangster family epic set in 1919 Birmingham, England; centered on a gang who sew razor blades in the peaks of their caps, and their fierce boss Tommy Shelby.

titles.description: Using a crack team of doctors and his wits, an antisocial maverick doctor specializing in diagnostic medicine does whatever it takes to solve puzzling cases that come his way.

titles.title: Quantico
titles.description: A look at the lives of young FBI recruits training at the Quantico base in Virginia when one of them is suspected of being a sleeper terrorist.

titles.title: Orphan Black
titles.description: A streetwise hustler is pulled into a compelling conspiracy after witnessing the suicide of a girl who looks just like her.

titles.title: Homeland

titles.title: Blindspot
titles.description: Jane Doe is found in Times Square with no memory and mysterious tattoos on her body.

titles.title: Legends of Tomorrow
titles.description: Time-traveling rogue Rip Hunter must recruit a ragtag team of heroes and villains to help prevent an apocalypse that could impact not only Earth, but all of time.

titles.title: The Handmaid's Tale
titles.description: Set in a dystopian future, a woman is forced to live as a concubine under a fundamentalist theocratic dictatorship.

titles.title: Chilling Adventures of Sabrina
titles.description: As her 16th birthday nears, Sabrina Spellman must reconcile her dual nature as a half-witch, half-mortal while fighting the evil forces that threaten her, her family, and the daylight world humans inhabit.

titles.title: The Good Doctor
titles.description: Young surgeon Shaun Murphy, who has autism and Savant Syndrome, is recruited into the surgical unit of a prestigious hospital.

titles.title: Jane the Virgin
titles.description: A young, devout Catholic woman discovers that she was accidentally artificially inseminated.

titles.title: Glee
titles.description: A group of ambitious misfits try to escape the harsh realities of high school by joining a glee club headed by a passionate Spanish teacher.

titles.title: South Park
titles.description: The misadventures of four foul-mouthed, dirty-minded, irreverent grade-schoolers who live in the quiet, dysfunctional mountain town of South Park, Colorado.

titles.description: Comedy series following the exploits of Det. Jake Peralta and his diverse, lovable colleagues as they police the NYPD's 99th Precinct.

titles.title: Under the Dome

titles.title: The Umbrella Academy
titles.description: A family of former child heroes, now grown apart, must reunite to continue to protect the world.

titles.title: True Detective
titles.description: Anthology series in which police investigations unearth the personal and professional secrets of those involved, both within and outside the law.

titles.title: The OA
titles.description: Having gone missing seven years ago, the previously blind Prairie returns home, now in her twenties with her sight restored. While many believe she is a miracle, others worry that she could be dangerous.

titles.title: Desperate Housewives
titles.description: A close-knit group of housewives reside in Wisteria Lane. It may appear to be a seemingly perfect neighborhood but it hides many secrets, crimes, forbidden romances and domestic struggles.

titles.title: Better Call Saul
titles.description: Albuquerque lawyer Jimmy McGill scrapes for clients and respect, but every win drags him closer to shady deals, dangerous players, and the alter ego Saul Goodman.

titles.title: Bates Motel
titles.description: An intimate look into the unraveling of Norman Bates' psyche throughout his teenage years.

titles.title: The Punisher
titles.description: After his revenge on those who murdered his family, aimless Marine veteran Frank Castle finds a new meaning in life as a vigilante known as "The Punisher".

titles.title: Atypical
titles.description: Sam, an 18-year-old on the autism spectrum, decides it's time to find a girlfriend, which sets Sam's mom on her own life-changing path as her son seeks more independence.

titles.title: Dynasty
titles.description: Follows two of America's wealthiest families as they feud for control over their fortune and their children.

titles.title: This Is Us
titles.description: A heartwarming and emotional story about a unique set of triplets, their struggles, and their wonderful parents.

titles.title: The Good Place
titles.description: Eleanor Shellstrop, a deceased saleswoman who lived a morally corrupt life, finds herself in a heaven-like afterlife in a case of mistaken identity and tries to hide her past in order to stay there.

titles.title: Iron Fist
titles.description: A young man is bestowed with incredible martial arts skills and a mystical force known as the Iron Fist.

titles.title: The Rain
titles.description: After a brutal virus wipes out most of the population, two young siblings embark on a perilous search for safety.

titles.title: Mindhunter
titles.description: In the late 1970s, two FBI agents broaden the realm of criminal science by investigating the psychology behind murder and end up getting too close to real-life monsters.

titles.title: Revenge
titles.description: An emotionally troubled young woman sets out to exact revenge against the people who wronged her father.

titles.title: Luke Cage
titles.description: When a sabotaged experiment gives him super strength and unbreakable skin, Luke Cage becomes a fugitive attempting to rebuild his life in Harlem and must confront his past and fight a battle for the heart of his city.

titles.title: Scandal
titles.description: A former White House Communications Director starts her own crisis management firm only to realize her clients are not the only ones with secrets.

titles.title: The Defenders

titles.description: The apparently-perfect lives of upper-class mothers of students at a prestigious elementary school unravel to the point of murder when a single mother moves to their quaint California beach town.

titles.title: Insatiable
titles.description: A disgraced, dissatisfied civil lawyer-turned-beauty pageant coach takes on a vengeful, bullied teenager as his client and has no idea what he's about to unleash upon the world.

titles.title: The Mentalist
titles.description: Famous "psychic" Patrick Jane outs himself as a fake, and using his heightened observational skills and impeccable knowledge of the human psyche, he works with the police so he can find "Red John", the madman who killed his family.

titles.title: The Crown
titles.description: Follows the political rivalries and romances of Queen Elizabeth II's reign and the events that shaped Britain for the second half of the 20th century.

titles.title: Chernobyl
titles.description: In April 1986, the city of Chernobyl in the Soviet Union suffers one of the worst nuclear disasters in the history of mankind. Consequently, many heroes put their lives on the line in the following days, weeks and months.

titles.title: iZombie

titles.title: Reign

titles.title: A Series of Unfortunate Events

titles.title: Criminal Minds
titles.description: The FBI's Behavioral Analysis Unit in Quantico helps police solve violent serial crimes using profiling. Team members analyze evidence and psychology to catch unknown subjects, but their demanding work affects personal lives.

titles.title: Scream
titles.description: A serialized anthology series that follows a group of teenagers being targeted by a masked serial killer.

titles.title: The Haunting of Hill House
titles.description: Flashing between past and present, a fractured family confronts haunting memories of their old home and the terrifying events that drove them from it.
